CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSDateFormat

Returns the date part of a date/time value as a string, using the conventions of the current locale. The mask characters are the same as for DateFormat.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSDateFormat(date [, mask ])

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.
mask
Optional. A DateFormat mask such as "mmmm d, yyyy", or one of the named formats short, medium, long and full. The default is dd-mmm-yy.

Returns

The formatted date as a string.

Usage

The named formats are the portable way to write international pages: they ask the locale for its own preferred layout. KoldFusion for UNIX formats with the English (US) conventions only (see SetLocale), so LSDateFormat gives the same result as DateFormat.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET D = CreateDate(2000, 1, 1)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Locale: #GetLocale()#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Mask</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>(none)</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(D)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>short</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(D, "short")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>medium</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(D, "medium")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>long</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(D, "long")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>full</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(D, "full")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

DateFormat, LSTimeFormat, LSParseDateTime, SetLocale
